description: 방송미디어통신위원회_WIFI 역사 정보 [telecommunications and railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 방송미디어통신위원회. 긴급구조 목적으로 구축한 데이터로써, WiFi AP 정보수집을 위한 전국 890개 실내 지하철 역사 정보로 역사아이디, 수집 타입(inner,outer), 역사이름(경복궁역 등) 등에. The portal shows 2026-01-16 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
